about: Limits for scripts/asset-budget.mjs (npm run assets:budget), in bytes of JavaScript as written to dist/. initialRaw and initialGzip are about 7% above what feat/route-code-splitting measured at e728bb7 on 2026-09-24, and were left alone at both merges of main since, because they still pass: at the merge of main 9108891 initial JS was 978854 B raw (+30164 over the previous merge, mainly main's sample-data and saved-search serving holds, which main.tsx starts before first paint), 2.6% under its limit. largestLazyRaw and totalRaw are about 7% above the 9108891 merge's own measurement. The chunk is Guided Setup, and it grew 63751 B raw (163515 -> 227266) when main's pack onboarding landed in it: OnboardingPanel, the onboarding plan and run, src/cribl/packClient.ts and src/cribl/packUpgrade.ts, which were unreachable at the previous merge. The previous note predicted this raise. Total JS grew by the same code (+87516 B, 1448063 -> 1535579). Raising a limit is allowed: say what grew and why in the commit.
